basic_details.job_title: IISER Kolkata Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Chemical Sciences, Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER), Kolkata, has invited applications for one Project Assistant post on the ANRF Advanced Research Grant project "Studying Elementary Steps in the Surface Chemistry of CO₂ on Copper Surfaces: A combined approach using molecular beam-surface scattering and theoretical methods". The post is for one year, extendable subject to performance and project requirements, with a fellowship as per ANRF/DST norms. B.Sc. in Physics or Chemistry is the essential qualification. qualification.details: B.Sc. in Physics or Chemistry from a recognized university. M.Sc. in Physics or Chemistry is preferable.

how_to_apply: The heading of the notice reads "Walk-in Interview / Online Application Invited". The notice prints no walk-in date or venue. The only way to apply it describes is by email.
Collect copies of all academic certificates and marksheets.
Add your contact details (phone number and email address).
Email the application with these documents to [email protected] within 15 days from the date of the advertisement. The notice prints the last date as 20 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: IISER Kolkata Project Assistant at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit, the application fee or the selection process.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER), Kolkata
Studying Elementary Steps in the Surface Chemistry of CO₂ on Copper Surfaces: A combined approach using molecular beam-surface scattering and theoretical methods
Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) – Advanced Research Grant (ARG) Program
One (1) year (extendable subject to performance and project requirements)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: B.Sc. in Physics or Chemistry from a recognized university. M.Sc. in Physics or Chemistry is preferable. Experience in Quantum Chemistry Calculations. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is as per ANRF/DST norms; the notice prints no amount. The duration is one year, extendable subject to performance and project requirements. The notice describes the post as purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: IISER Kolkata Project Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will carry out quantum and classical dynamics calculations to study molecular collisions with metal surfaces. The research involves theoretical and computational investigations into the surface chemistry of CO₂ on copper surfaces, using molecular beam-surface scattering and related theoretical methods.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Kolkata Project Assistant
content_sections.text: The heading of the notice reads "Walk-in Interview / Online Application Invited". The notice prints no walk-in date or venue. The only way to apply it describes is by email.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Assistant vacancies are there at IISER Kolkata?
faq.answer: There is 01 (One) vacancy for Project Assistant in the Department of Chemical Sciences, IISER Kolkata.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IISER Kolkata Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 20 November 2026. The notice asks for applications within 15 days from the advertisement date of 05 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IISER Kolkata Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is B.Sc. in Physics or Chemistry from a recognized university. M.Sc. in Physics or Chemistry is preferable, and experience in Quantum Chemistry Calculations is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the IISER Kolkata Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The notice states the fellowship as "As per ANRF/DST norms" and prints no amount.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for IISER Kolkata Project Assistant?
faq.answer: Send an email to [email protected] with an updated CV, copies of all academic certificates and marksheets, and your contact details (phone number and email address).

faq.question: Q6. How long is the IISER Kolkata Project Assistant appointment?
faq.answer: The duration is one year, extendable subject to performance and project requirements.

faq.question: Q7. Is the IISER Kolkata Project Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice calls it a purely temporary position co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q8. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending any interview/interaction.

faq.question: Q9. What is the project that the Project Assistant will work on?
faq.answer: The project is "Studying Elementary Steps in the Surface Chemistry of CO₂ on Copper Surfaces", funded by ANRF under its Advanced Research Grant (ARG) Program. Dr. Ashwani Kumar Tiwari is the Principal Investigator.
